items.html: These 315 sparks of ZA are the phase of what was clarified from those seven kings, by the secret of the aforementioned clarification, through Aba and Ima. Then Aba brought down a drop of male waters called Hesed, comprised of the five Hassadim. And Ima too brought down a drop of female waters comprising the five Gevurot. And through these drops the 315 sparks of ZA were clarified and corrected, and so likewise with the 315 sparks of the Nukva.
